# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM updates and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL for .NET 9.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Native library targets now use the versioned 26.0 TFM and app targets use the unversioned forms, aligning v3 with the Apple platform conventions introduced in v4. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed** — The WinUI projection assembly was not resolved correctly in .NET 9 consumer projects. The package now includes the correct resolution path. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
